name: Semi-Welded Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: The official page says THT uses advanced fiber-laser welding machines and modern laser welding technology for semi-welded plate heat exchangers. Compared with other welding methods, the page highlights a single-weld process, small heat-affected zone, low post-weld deformation, automatic inspection during welding, fast welding speed, and low residual-stress ratio. The page also states that the product has obtained B2-B3 level safety registration certification for welded plate heat exchangers.
advantage: Laser welding process with small heat-affected zone and low deformation.
Automatic inspection during welding helps control weld quality.
Guide-plate mechanical tests can verify plate-pair welding quality.
Officially listed B2-B3 safety registration certification for welded plate heat exchangers.

technical_parameters.Welding Method: Fiber laser welding and CNC seam welding
technical_parameters.Safety Registration: B2-B3 level welded plate heat exchanger safety registration

seo_data.meta_description: Semi-welded plate heat exchanger using laser welding and plate-pair welding processes for duties where one side requires welded sealing.
